notes: Fixes reminders being suppressed when a paired household phone is offline. Configured visual and spoken reminders now appear with a household-status warning when presence cannot be verified; a fresh Home report still suppresses the routine, and other conditional actions wait for confirmed Away reports. Also fixes unreadable Wi-Fi being treated as Away, refreshes Wi-Fi on each heartbeat, and improves Setup check-in diagnostics. Update your phone to restore the reminder fallback; update every household phone for the reporting improvements.
